name: folder
label: Folder
help: For example `invoices/2026`. Missing folders are created. Leave it empty for the root of the bucket.

name: data
label: Data
help: The content of the file, for example from an HTTP or a cloud storage module.

name: conflict
label: If the name is taken
help: What to do when a file with this name exists in the folder.

name: contentType
label: Content type
help: The MIME type, for example `application/pdf`. Leave it empty and the storage provider stores a generic type.
